## Summary
Add a short contributor-facing documentation note that explains how to validate the OpenAgent workflow configuration locally.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The change is documentation-only.
- The note states the exact local validation command: `pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/Test-AiWorkflow.ps1`.
- The note states the expected success output: `AI delivery-loop contract passed.`
- `README.md` links to the note if the note lives outside the README.
- Parent: #6
